prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Mina Castellan after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Dental clinic expansion model
client: Sunrise Dental Partners
client_industry: healthcare
start: 2022-11
end: 2022-12
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Excel
- financial modeling
implied_skills:
- scenario analysis
built: A three-site expansion model with best, base and worst cases for patient volume
  and staffing.
metrics:
- 3 sites compared
- chosen site projected to pay back in 14 months

The review is from: Sunrise Dental Partners
Rating: 4.8 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on technical quality; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "scenario analysis".
text: Mina delivered a solid Excel model for our dental clinic expansion. The work was technically strong, well-structured, and made it easy to compare the three site options under different operating assumptions. The chosen site showed a projected payback of 14 months, which was exactly the kind of decision support we needed. Would work with her again.
